title: Real-World IQ Dataset for Automatic Radio Modulation Recognition under Multipath Channels
role: optional external real-world validation dataset for SPECTRA
note: This dataset is an INPUT to validation only. Its published baseline accuracy (84.3% test accuracy reported by the dataset authors) is NOT a SPECTRA result and must never be reported as one.

hdf5_layout.X: (N, 1024, 2) float16 IQ pairs (I in [:, 0], Q in [:, 1])

git.reason: ~833 MB of binary data; not appropriate for Git

honest_limits: SNR coverage is 20-30 dB only: this dataset can say nothing about low-SNR behaviour, in either direction.
7 coarse classes (QAM is not split into 16/64/256-QAM; there is no 8-PSK, FSK, OOK, AM or noise class).
Captured at 2 MSps / 2.4 GHz with a HackRF One; SPECTRA's synthetic chain runs at 8 kHz baseband. Sample-rate domain shift applies.
The 84.3% baseline in the bundled paper was produced by the dataset authors' TensorFlow model, not by SPECTRA.
